StartTitle: Work with PDF locally and safely
StartOpenHint: Open a document or drop PDF files into this window
RestoreAfterCrash: The previous session ended unexpectedly. Restore open documents?
LanguageRestartNote: The interface language will change after restarting the app.
AboutText: Full PDF work on your own computer: viewing and organizing pages, editing text and images, annotations and drawing, forms, signatures, scan recognition, redaction, comparison and conversion.
AboutEngineRender: PDFium — page rendering, text and content editing
AboutEngineStructure: qpdf — file structure, AES-256 encryption, optimization
AboutPrivacy: Your documents never leave the computer: no feature needs the internet.
AboutNoticesMissing: The license list file was not found: {0}
PrintJobQueued: Job sent to the printer: {0} sheets, printer "{1}".
PrintNothingToShow: Nothing to show: check the page selection
PrintSheetClipped: Content is clipped on this sheet
ProtectIntro: A copy of the document encrypted with AES-256 will be created. The password will be required to open it.
FileOpenElsewhere: This file is open in another NexusPDF tab or window. Close it there or choose a different file name.
HFTemplateHint: Placeholders: {n} — page number, {N} — total pages, {file} — file name, {date} — date.
FontSizeInvalid: Font size must be a number from 4 to 144.
DecorApplied: Decoration added (will be baked on save)
PlaceHint: Click on a page to place the content (Esc — cancel)
SigIntro: The library is stored only on this computer and is encrypted with your Windows account key. A visual signature is an image; it is not a cryptographic digital signature.
SigEmpty: No templates yet — add a signature image (PNG with a transparent background looks best).
PlaceRectHint: Drag a rectangle on a page (Esc — cancel)
FormModeHint: Click a form field and type; save the document to commit the values
FormFlattenedWarning: Saved. Due to structural edits the interactive form was flattened to static content
CopyFailed: Copy failed: the clipboard is held by another program.
LinkConfirmQuestion: The document wants to open an external address in your browser. Opening links from untrusted documents is risky. Full address:
LinkUnsupportedScheme: This link does not point to the web or e-mail, so it is not opened: the program never launches external files or apps on a document's request.
LinkTargetMissing: The page this link points to is not present in the current document.
AnnotRedactionText: Content under the area will be removed on save
RedactTool: Redact area (content is REMOVED on save)
RedactHint: Drag a box over the area: on save the content underneath is DESTROYED and the page becomes an image (Ctrl+Z to undo before saving).
RedactionApplied: Redactions applied: content removed, redacted pages rasterized.
SignIntro: A copy with an invisible cryptographic signature (PKCS#7, SHA-256) will be created. The signature certifies authenticity and integrity of the file.
SignNoCerts: No certificates with a private key in the Windows personal store. Pick a PFX/P12 file.
SignVisibleStamp: Visible stamp at the bottom of the first page
SignVisibleStampHint: The signer name and date are baked into the page and covered by the signature. For documents with forms the fields become static.
SignNoPrivateKey: The certificate has no private key — nothing to sign with.
SignPfxError: Could not open the PFX file:
SignAlreadySigned: The document already contains signatures. Re-signing would rebuild the file and break them — save the edited copy under a different name and sign that.
SignNotModified: The document has not been modified since signing
SignModifiedAfter: The document WAS MODIFIED after signing
SignUntrusted: The certificate chain is not trusted (e.g. self-signed)
OcrIntro: Scanned pages without a text layer are recognized locally, no internet. Pages that already have text are skipped. Choose the engine, the document language and what to do with the recognized text below.
OcrResultNoWords: Pages with no recognizable text (blank or unreadable): {0}.
OcrSaveHint: The text is already searchable, selectable and copyable. Save the document (Ctrl+S) to keep it in the file. Ctrl+Z removes the recognized layer page by page.
OcrCancelled: Recognition cancelled. Pages recognized so far are kept.
ExportImagesIntro: Each selected page will be saved as a separate PNG or JPEG file into the chosen folder.
MergeNeedTwo: Select at least two PDF files.
ConvertTargetIsOpen: This file is currently open in NexusPDF. Close the tab or choose another name.
BatchIntro: One operation for a set of PDF files. Results are written to the chosen folder under the same names; one file's error does not stop the rest.
BatchNeedFiles: Add files and choose an output folder.
BatchSameFolder: The result would overwrite the source file — choose another folder.
BatchTimeout: the operation did not finish within 5 minutes
PaintEditRegionMode: How to return the edited area
PaintEditRegionOverlay: Place on top (the page stays textual)
PaintEditRegionOverlayHint: Fast and keeps the page text. IMPORTANT: the previous content under the picture REMAINS in the file and can be extracted. To hide secret data use redaction or the mode below.
PaintEditRegionDestroy: Replace and destroy the previous content
PaintEditRegionDestroyHint: The previous content under the area disappears physically. The cost: the whole page becomes an image and loses its text layer (OCR can restore it).
FormHint: Turn the mode on and click the document fields to fill them in.
OrganizeHint: Select pages with the mouse, drag to reorder, rotate and delete.
OcrModeTitle: What to do with the recognized text
OcrModeSearchable: Keep the scan as is, add text for search
OcrModeSearchableHint: The page looks exactly as it does now. The text is invisible: search, selection and copy work through it. Use this when the original look matters.
OcrModeEditableHint: Scanned lines are replaced with ordinary text: click a line with Edit → Text to change it. The cost: the original typeface is replaced with a system font, so the page look changes.
OcrEditableHint: Done. Click any line with Edit → Text to change it. Ctrl+Z undoes page by page.
QpdfMissing: The qpdf component was not found next to the program, so this operation is unavailable. Please reinstall NexusPDF.
LayersHint: Clear a checkbox to stop a layer from being drawn. The setting is written into a copy of the file and applies in any program. The content of a hidden layer STAYS in the file — use redaction to remove sensitive data.
LayersSaveCopy: Save a copy with these layers…
LayersNeedSavedFile: Layers are read from the file on disk — save the document first.
AttachmentsWarning: This program does NOT open attachments — it can only save them to disk. A PDF attachment is a common way to deliver a malicious file, so scan whatever you save before running it.
AttachmentsNone: This document has no attached files.
TextEditHint: Click the line you want to change.
TextEditNotFound: There is no text at that point. Click directly on the letters; scanned text cannot be edited this way — run OCR first.
TextEditFontInfo: Font: {0}, {1} pt, {2}. Editing keeps the font, size, colour and position of the line.
TextEditFontMissingGlyphs: This font is missing some of the characters you typed — they will not be drawn. Embedded fonts often contain only the letters already used in the document. Change the text, or add a separate text block instead.
DrawAutoStraightenHint: An almost straight pencil stroke becomes a clean line; you can restore the freehand stroke afterwards.
DrawRestoreFreeHint: Undoes the automatic straightening of the last line and brings your handwriting back.
DrawHintPencil: Drag to draw. Hand jitter is smoothed automatically.
DrawHintLine: Drag to draw a line. Hold Shift for 45° steps.
DrawHintArrow: Drag from the start to the target. Hold Shift for 45° steps.
DrawStraightened: The line was straightened automatically. You can restore the freehand stroke.
OutlinePageMissing: The page this bookmark points to was removed from the document.
PaintImageHint: Click an image on the page — a photo, a logo, a scan.
PaintImageNotFound: There is no image at that point. Pick a picture, or use region editing instead.
PaintImageDone: Image replaced in place: position, size and the page text are preserved (Ctrl+Z to undo).
PaintRegionHint: Drag a box over the area you want to edit in the external editor.
PaintRegionOverlayDone: The area was placed on top of the page. The previous content under it remains in the file.
PaintRegionDestroyDone: The area was replaced and the previous content destroyed; the page became an image.
PaintEditWarningPage: The page content is exported as an image and will replace the current content after editing: text and vector graphics ON THIS PAGE stop being text. Links, annotations and form fields are preserved — they are not page content. Page size, boxes and rotation stay unchanged. Undo with Ctrl+Z.
PaintEditWarningRegion: The edited area returns to the same page coordinates. The rest of the page is untouched.
PaintEditOcrAfter: Recognize text after returning from the editor
PaintEditOcrHint: The page becomes an image, so its text layer can be restored by OCR (rus+eng).
PaintNoEditor: No image editor found. Install Microsoft Paint from the Microsoft Store or choose another editor in settings.
PaintCancelled: Editing cancelled, the document is unchanged.
PaintImported: Changes from the editor applied to the page (Ctrl+Z to undo).
PaintWaitIntro: The page is open in an external editor. Edit it and SAVE the file (Ctrl+S) — you do not have to close the editor. Then press “Import changes”.
PaintWaitWaiting: Waiting for a save from the editor…
PaintWaitSaved: File saved — the changes are ready to import.
PaintWaitEditorClosedNoChanges: The editor was closed with no saved changes.
CompressIntro: Pictures and scans above the target resolution are downscaled and re-encoded as JPEG — the file gets much smaller at the cost of image quality. Text and vector graphics are untouched. Transparent images and fax codecs are skipped. The original file is not modified — a copy is created.
CompressNoGain: The file did not get smaller: {0} → {1} (recompressed: {2}) — the copy was created but with no gain.
CompareIntro: Pick two PDF files and press Compare: pages are compared visually, differences are highlighted in red. Files are compared AS SAVED on disk — unsaved edits are not included.
CompareProtected: One of the files is password-protected — comparing protected files is not supported yet.
CompareTextTooLong: The page is too long for word-level text comparison.
PropsJavaScriptFound: yes, scripts: {0} ({1}) — NOT executed by this program
PropsAttachmentsFound: yes, files: {0} ({1}) — opening is not supported
PropsLaunchFound: the document contains launch actions — this program NEVER executes them
ActiveContentBanner: This document contains active content: {0}. The program does not execute or open it.
PasswordPrompt: The file “{0}” is password-protected. Enter the open password:
PasswordWrong: The password didn't match. Try again.
ErrorSaveFile: Could not save “{0}”. The original file was not modified.
OrganizeHint: Select pages with the mouse (Ctrl/Shift for multiple), drag to reorder
